description: This file defines styling for React components using Material-UI's makeStyles. It includes theme-based styles, background images, and layout styles for various sections of a web page, such as headers, containers, and banners.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: A hook that provides styling classes for React components based on theme and layout.

methods.name: useStyles
methods.description: A React hook created by makeStyles to generate and access CSS classes for styling components.
